description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kudakanda, Weligepola D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620120
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
